bell.title: Notifications
bell.label: {count, plural, =0 {Notifications} other {Notifications, # unread}}
bell.empty: Nothing yet. You hear here when something needs you, such as a customer opening a link you shared.
bell.impersonating: You see {name}'s notifications. Only they can mark them read.

preferences.title: Notifications
preferences.intro: Your bell always shows what happened. Choose what also reaches you by email, and as a push notification on devices where you turn push on.
preferences.kindWins: A choice for one kind of notification wins over Everything.

everything.label: Everything
everything.hint: Every kind of notification, unless you choose otherwise for one below.

shareLinkOpened.label: A customer opens a link you shared
shareLinkOpened.hint: Repeat opens of the same link are held back for a while.

leadAssigned.label: A lead is given to you
leadAssigned.hint: When someone else makes you a lead's owner.

leadRepeatEnquiry.label: A customer asks again
leadRepeatEnquiry.hint: When a repeat enquiry is added to one of your open leads.

importFinished.label: An import of yours ends
importFinished.hint: When the rows of a file you imported have been added, or the import stopped.

exportReady.label: An export you asked for is ready
exportReady.hint: When the file of leads or staff you asked for can be downloaded.

preferences.noEmail: You sign in without an email address, so no email is sent to you.
preferences.impersonating: Only {name} can change these: what reaches them is their choice.

push.heading: On this device
push.label: Push notifications
push.onHint: This device shows a notification when something reaches you by push.
push.offHint: Turn it on to get push notifications on this device. Your browser asks you first.
push.unsupported: This browser can't receive push notifications. On an iPhone or iPad, add the app to your Home Screen and open it from there.
push.noWorker: This page hasn't started the app's offline support, which push needs. Reload the page and try again.
push.blocked: Your browser blocks notifications from this app. Allow them in the browser's settings for this site, then reload the page.
push.failed: This browser couldn't turn push on. Try again in a moment.
push.impersonating: Support can't turn push on for {name}: it would reach support's device, not theirs.
push.fallbackBody: Open the app to see what happened.
